dedupe_keys.name: ngmn recommendation on base station antenna standards n p basta whitepaper v11 1

description: This NGMN whitepaper recommends standards for base station antennas: performance criteria, electrical and mechanical parameter definitions, calculation and measurement practices for validation and production, datasheet creation and delivery, and methods for electronic exchange of antenna data. It also recommends how to apply existing environmental and reliability standards to base station antennas. Version 11.1 is dated 6 March 2019, was approved by the NGMN Board on 15 February 2019 and is a public final deliverable of 166 pages, edited by Andre Fournier of Amphenol Antenna Solutions with contributors from antenna vendors and operators including CommScope, Huawei, Kathrein, RFS, Deutsche Telekom, Telecom Italia and Telefonica. Producer: NGMN Alliance. Coverage: passive base station antennas, worldwide. Access: a free PDF on the NGMN website. Licence and cost: copyright NGMN e.V., no part may be reproduced without written permission, and the text says no licence to intellectual property is granted; free to read. Caveats: the document says readers should not design products from it and it is a specification, not a dataset of antenna measurements. Simulation uses: the parameter definitions and datasheet formats give consistent antenna inputs for radio coverage and capacity-planning models. Related record: the 3GPP specifications (data-3gpp-specifications).
